configuration.reason: Review-only defaults selected on 60 draft synthetic tuning pairs per mode; not independently reviewed or calibrated. Validate with reviewed local data before operational tuning.

predictor: signals-v2 relationshipCandidate maps to duplicate/related/unrelated-undetermined. Mandatory review is reported separately through flagged; undetermined is not a confirmed unrelated decision.
thresholdProtocol: Deterministic threshold grid selected using only 60 tuning pairs per mode; weights/date window unchanged. Settings frozen before Phase 6 held-out evaluation, with no fitting on held-out labels. See phase6-tuning-selection.json. Different-institution gating is part of the pipeline, not an embedding result.

tuning.macroPolicy: Mean over labels with actual support or predictions; undefined precision/recall contributes zero for such a label. No samples -> null. Per-class absent denominators remain null.
